cat-products.description: Explore eight cat product sourcing categories, private-label customisation and supplier coordination with KOVA, an independent China-based service for international pet brands.

categories.title: Cat Beds & Cushions
categories.description: Comfortable resting options with materials and forms to suit your collection.
categories.options: Bolster beds, enclosed beds, flat cushions and removable covers.
categories.customization: Cotton, bouclé or linen-look fabrics; filling, bed sizes, cover colours, embroidery, labels and packaging.
categories.alt: AI-generated concept illustrating Cat Beds & Cushions

categories.title: Cat Trees & Scratching
categories.description: Explore climbing and scratching products designed around home interiors.
categories.options: Sisal posts, scratching boards, multi-level trees and replacement pads.
categories.customization: Wood or plywood, sisal or jute; heights, layouts, upholstery colours, finishes and replacement components.
categories.alt: AI-generated concept illustrating Cat Trees & Scratching

categories.title: Cat Toys & Enrichment
categories.description: Species-appropriate play accessories in a range of textures and formats.
categories.options: Feather wands, felt balls, play tunnels and enrichment sets.
categories.customization: Felt, cotton rope, rubber or textiles; toy sizes, textures, colour palettes, set combinations and packaging.
categories.alt: AI-generated concept illustrating Cat Toys & Enrichment

categories.title: Feeding & Drinking
categories.description: Everyday mealtime accessories with practical shapes and considered finishes.
categories.options: Ceramic bowls, stainless steel bowls, feeding mats and water dishes.
categories.customization: Ceramic, stainless steel or silicone; bowl capacities, mat sizes, colours, suitable logo placement and packaging.

categories.title: Cat Carriers & Travel
categories.description: Practical options for carrying cats and organising their travel essentials.
categories.options: Soft-sided carriers, travel mats, carrier liners and accessory pouches.
categories.customization: Canvas or polyester, mesh and webbing; carrier sizes, entry openings, straps, pockets, colours and labels.
categories.alt: AI-generated concept illustrating Cat Carriers & Travel

categories.title: Grooming & Care
categories.description: Tools and accessories for regular grooming and everyday care.
categories.options: Brushes, combs, grooming mitts and coordinated accessory sets.
categories.customization: Wood or bamboo handles, stainless steel or silicone; brush and comb styles, handle finishes, labels and accessory sets.

categories.title: Cat Litter Accessories
categories.description: Explore accessories for tidier litter routines and different home layouts.
categories.options: Litter trays, scoops, litter-trapping mats and scoop holders.
categories.customization: Plastic, silicone or stainless steel, depending on the item; tray sizes, scoop shapes, mat textures, colours and packaging.
categories.alt: AI-generated concept illustrating Cat Litter Accessories

categories.title: Cat Collars & Accessories
categories.description: Small accessories with fit, fastening and everyday use in mind.
categories.options: Breakaway collars, cat harnesses, leads and identification tag holders.
categories.customization: Nylon or polyester webbing and fabric; fit ranges, breakaway fastening options, colours, labels and packaging.
categories.alt: AI-generated concept illustrating Cat Collars & Accessories
